Active Age Programme

Active Age is our movement programme for older adults in retirement villages. It adapts the proven methods behind our preschool programme to maintain mobility, coordination, confidence and cognitive function through enjoyable, low-impact activity.

Bring Active Age to your village
MOVEMENT.MIND.CONFIDENCE.
THE PROTEUS WAY / RETIREMENT VILLAGES

WHO IT’S FOR

Retirement villages and elderly care providers looking for engagement and respite programmes that support residents’ health, independence and wellbeing.

01

Safe and inclusive

Low-impact, age-appropriate activities led by Proteus-trained coaches, with chair-based options and minimal equipment or space needed.

02

Body and mind

Balance and fall-prevention, hand–eye and foot–eye coordination, and reaction-based games that keep the mind sharp.

03

Social and enjoyable

A positive group environment that encourages connection, so participants rediscover the joy of moving.

  • 30–45 minSessions
  • Indoors or outSmall groups
  • Chair-basedOptions for every ability

Session structure

  • Gentle warm-up & mobility
  • Coordination & motor-skill activities
  • Cognitive & reaction games
  • Balance & stability
  • Cool-down & relaxation

HERE TO HELP

GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Ask us something else
How long is a session?

Sessions run for 30 to 45 minutes, indoors or outdoors, in small groups.

Is it suitable for residents with limited mobility?

Yes. Activities are low-impact and age-appropriate, with chair-based options for every ability.

What do we need to provide?

Very little. Sessions need minimal equipment and space, and are led by Proteus-trained coaches.

Which programme is right for us?

Tell us who the programme is for, your sport and what you want to achieve. Our team can discuss the options for an individual player, preschool, school, club, community organisation or retirement village.
